newsitem.title: USA: Enron and Houston firm form 50/50 venture.
newsitem.headline: Enron and Houston firm form 50/50 venture.

text.p: Enron Corp said its Enron Capital & Trade Resources Corp unit formed a 50/50 joint venture with SCF Partners -- a Houston-based investment company -- to provide financing and capital to companies in the energy service and equipment industry.
The new company -- called EnSerCo -- will have $115 million of available capital to begin, Enron said.

The company will serve small-to-medium-sized companies that provide equipment and services to the exploration, development, completion, production, transportation and processing sectors of the energy industry, Enron said.
